'''Branko Stanovnik''' (born August 11, 1938) is a [[Slovenia]]n [[chemist]], specializing in [[organic chemistry]], and member of the [[Slovenian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] (SAZU).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.dolenjskilist.si/2010/10/14/34234/gospodarstvo/splosno/Z_akademijo_pocastili_40_let_Krkinih_nagrad/|title=Z akademijo počastili 40 let Krkinih nagrad|last=Gornik|first=B. Dušič|date=14 October 2010|work=Dolenjski list|accessdate=21 March 2011}}</ref>

== Academic background ==
Stanovnik graduated from the Department of Chemistry of the Faculty of Mining and Technology, [[University of Ljubljana]]. He received his doctorate in organic chemistry in 1964, and was elected Assistant Professor in 1964, Associate Professor in 1967 and Full Professor of organic chemistry in 1972.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Branko Stanovnik |url=https://www.medjchem.com/public/journals/1/cv/cvstanovnic.pdf |access-date=2024-07-30 |website=medjchem.com}}</ref>

== Academic and research contributions ==
Stanovnik has been an associate member of SAZU since 1991, and a full member since 1995. Since 1999 he has been the head of the SAUL International Cooperation and Scientific Coordination.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Branko Stanovnik |url=http://www.sazu.si/en/members/branko-stanovnik |access-date=2024-07-30 |website=www.sazu.si |language=en}}</ref>

He has been a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] in London since 1984, and a regular member of [[New York Academy of Sciences|The New York Academy of Sciences]] since 1995.<ref name=":0" /> He is also a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members |url=https://members.euro-acad.eu/#memberList |access-date=2024-07-30 |website=members.euro-acad.eu}}</ref>

Stanovnik was the head of the Chemistry Department in 1967-1968 and 1968-1969, Head of the Chair of Organic Chemistry 1984-89, Deputy Head of the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Technology, Faculty of Natural Sciences and Technology 1992-95, Vice-Dean of the Faculty of Chemistry and Chemical Technology 1995-97.<ref name=":1" />

He has published more than 550 scientific and professional papers, mainly in international journals.<ref name=":1" />

== Awards ==
Stanovnik won the Kidric Fund Award for Science in 1972, the Boris Kidric Award and Medal for Science in 1977 and the Honorary Medal and Diploma of [[Technical University of Bratislava]] in 1975.<ref name=":0" />

In 2007, he received the Kametani Award and the Medal and Diploma "In Memory of Professor A. N. Kost".<ref name=":0" />

Stanovnik was awarded the Zois Lifetime Achievement Award in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Highest State Awards in the Field of Scientific-Research and Science Development Activities have been Conferred |url=https://ung.si/en/news/news/5645/the-highest-state-awards-in-the-field-of-scientific-research-and-science-development-activities-have-been-conferred/ |access-date=2024-07-30 |website=ung.si |language=en}}</ref>
